rejected_assumptions: text-input-v3 done serial is not a widget-processing acknowledgement; direct text/pointer/text crossed GTK fields
An IBus engine marker receipt alone does not prove Qt has applied text; both synchronous and asynchronous Qt IBus failed without poll-delay masking
IBus hybrid mode 2 nested dispatch can reorder GTK input under pressure; it is not the synchronous post-processing contract
Newer sandbox libxkbcommon rejects keycodes above 0xfff; fixture private markers use 2048..2079 and disable repetition
Flatpak 1.14 does not expose a relocated private document mount at the path returned by GetMountPoint; a bounded facade to the official headless host document service is prototyped

Weston XWM requires frame PNG assets even for client-decorated windows; failing to set private WESTON_DATA_DIR aborts on hosts without system Weston, while a preinstalled host Weston can hide the defect
Verified GTK archives alone are insufficient for private file dialogs: MIME, schema and image loader caches must be derived; missing MIME data caused an actual GTK chooser assertion
XDG_DESKTOP_PORTAL_DIR overrides both backend descriptions and portal configuration; separating them silently restores fallback interfaces

Portal 1.20 validates the bwrap process through metadata under the actual Flatpak launcher runtime, not an unrelated service or host runtime directory; the private portal resolves the original instance metadata without copying or fabricating it

WESTON_LAYER_POSITION_HIDDEN still renders. It requires an opaque background; removing the layer instead loses native mapping/callback behavior. The private shell covers inactive surfaces and clears prior pixels without a user desktop.
xdg_popup commits are not top-level shell commits. Damage follows the native desktop parent chain; transient toplevel parent metadata has a separate shell callback and must be registered explicitly.

Weston 14 accepts only the last keyboard serial for popup grabs: a release arriving before a press-triggered GTK request dismisses the popup. Actual protocol traces prove the failure. The bounded per-focus keyboard serial history fixes this without delaying or replaying keys.

Weston 14 advertises wl_seat version 7 and cannot deliver high-resolution wheel metadata. GTK 4.14 discards the first smooth scroll delta in the tested scrolled window. The reviewed source patch enables standard value120 on seat version 8, with native legacy detents and per-target fractional remainder.
